answer_1.quote: Quality estimation (QE) of MT aims to evaluate the quality of the outputs of an MT system without references. ... We propose a self-supervised QE method to overcome the aforementioned weaknesses.
answer_1.outputs: Sentence-level quality scores (HTER / Pearson correlation) and word-level quality tags (OK/BAD) with associated confidence scores

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the performances of our method and the baselines using the standard metrics of the WMT QE shared tasks. Specifically, we used Pearson's correlation metric for sentence-level tasks and the multiplication of F1-scores for "OK" and "BAD" classes for word-level tasks.
